verify_versions.description: Version consistency across README, module, contracts, and release notes

verify_registry.description: Registry integrity checks for Capability Register, Tool Registry, and Tool Manifest

verify_contracts.description: Contract presence verification and source file mapping

verify_imports.description: Import boundary enforcement for production code

verify_tests.description: Test suite structural audit (file count, function count, skipped tests)

verify_documentation.description: Documentation synchronization audit for key engineering documents

verify_governance.description: Comprehensive repository governance validation including Engineering Register, EQ packages, authority documents, evidence structure, and tool placement

verify_links.description: Automated verification of all markdown links including internal references, relative paths, Engineering Register references, and cross-document links

verify_evidence.description: Engineering Question evidence validation including authority documents, evidence packages, completeness, orphaned/duplicate detection, and structure validation

verify_tools.description: Tool classification and placement validation ensuring proper categorization as reusable or historical evidence with architectural justification

verify_register.description: Specialized Engineering Register validation for unique EQ numbers, authority document existence, evidence package existence, valid paths, and status values
